title: Groundwater Cell Tile Mapping and Aggregation Primitive
objective: Define a runtime-owned, model-agnostic tile-to-groundwater-cell mapping and area-weighted aggregation primitive supporting multiple surface fractions per groundwater cell without exposing cell fractions to the SWAP kernel.
required_semantics: one groundwater cell may own multiple tiles
tile fractions are explicit finite positive values
cell fractions must sum to one under a fixed machine-precision identity rule and are never silently normalized
SWAP and non-SWAP tiles can coexist because aggregation consumes typed tile exchange contributions rather than solver objects
cell flux is area-weighted sum of tile fluxes
tile lineage remains visible for diagnostics
invalid or duplicate tile mappings fail closed
no kernel ownership of area fractions
qualification: order-independent aggregation within floating-point identity envelope
